strings.name: Andrew Forrest
strings.role: Mining entrepreneur · Energy-transition and philanthropy advocate
strings.summary: Forrest moved from stockbroking and nickel into iron ore, founding Fortescue in 2003 and developing a major mining and infrastructure business. He and his family established philanthropy supporting oceans and anti-slavery work, while he promoted mine-decarbonization investment. Green-hydrogen expansion faces economic constraints; mining operations also face Indigenous land-rights disputes. Transition targets remain commitments to deliver.
strings.coverageNote: Selected verifiable milestones through 13 November 2026; not a real-time news archive.
strings.influence.rationale: Founded Fortescue, expanded iron-ore production and invested in green energy and philanthropy against modern slavery.
strings.facts.f1.label: Birth
strings.facts.f2.label: Education
strings.facts.f2.value: BA majoring in economics, Western Australia(1983); PhD in marine science(2019).
strings.highlights.h1.title: Iron-ore enterprise
strings.highlights.h1.text: Founded Fortescue and developed integrated Pilbara mining, rail and port operations.
strings.highlights.h2.title: Philanthropy and transition
strings.highlights.h2.text: Supported Minderoo and anti-slavery work and promoted mining decarbonization; targets are distinguished from results.
strings.timeline.t1.title: Left foundation co-chair role
strings.timeline.t1.text: He and Nicola stepped down as Minderoo co-chairs, retaining founder status.
strings.timeline.t2.title: Decarbonization investment plan
strings.timeline.t2.text: Fortescue proposed a $6.2 billion plan targeting elimination of fossil fuels in Australian mining operations by 2030.
strings.timeline.t3.title: Marine-science doctorate
strings.timeline.t3.text: Received a marine-science PhD from Western Australia.
strings.timeline.t4.title: Giving Pledge
strings.timeline.t4.text: With Nicola, pledged at least half their wealth to philanthropy.
strings.timeline.t5.title: First ore shipment
strings.timeline.t5.text: Fortescue began shipping iron ore to China.
strings.timeline.t6.title: Founded Fortescue
strings.timeline.t6.text: Took over and reorganized an exploration company for Pilbara iron-ore development.
strings.timeline.t7.title: Philanthropic foundation
strings.timeline.t7.text: Established the Australian Children’s Trust with Nicola, later developing into Minderoo.
strings.timeline.t8.title: Economics education
strings.timeline.t8.text: Graduated from Western Australia before working in stockbroking and resources.
